# Damage

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Damage and Healing](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Damage)*

Damage represents harm that causes a creature or an object to lose [Hit Points](../Stats/Hit-Points.md).
